answer: Sponsorship bonding: each agent gets three invitation berths, jetty slots, per epoch, and the 25,000 POA posted per identity into the shared vault also locks its own stake. Credit lands only after a newcomer settles outside its invite subtree; internal transfers count zero. To forge 1,000 puppets an attacker freezes 25,000,000 POA behind 400 corrupt sponsors; one honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. On cycle or collusion proof, 100% of the bond is seized, 50% burned, 50% to the reporter, both banned 10 epochs. Limitation: rich syndicates still buy berths, so cost rises while wealth bias stays.
